repairs.quote: After using an Ability, Sylas gains a charge (max 3 charges). Sylas' Attacks expend a charge to whirl his chains, dealing ((130% Attack Damage) + (30% Ability Power)) magic damage to the main target and ((40% Attack Damage) + (20% Ability Power)) magic damage to other surrounding enemies. While he has at least one charge, Sylas gains 125% Attack Speed.
